name: keyhole
description: Manage the local directory grants behind your private ChatGPT app: read-only by default, explicit rw for version-checked, recoverable text edits.

interface.shortDescription: Local folder grants for your private ChatGPT app.
interface.longDescription: Open, close, resume and inspect the local directories shared with your own ChatGPT app through OpenAI's Secure MCP Tunnel. New grants are read-only; explicit rw enables hash-checked, recoverable edits of UTF-8 text. No remote grants, no shell.
interface.defaultPrompt: Inspect Keyhole status or manage the directory grants the user explicitly asked for.
